meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: Explore-first planning consultant that writes one decision-complete work plan before coding. Use only on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow or a plan before implementation; it never self-activates on a bare ulw run.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编码前产出决策完备的实施计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果不先理清方案就写代码总返工。
copy.tagline_en: Produce a decision-complete work plan before coding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear work plan before starting implementation.

howto.what: 启用后,Claude 以“规划顾问”角色工作:先探索代码、理清意图,经你同意后产出一份可照做、无需追问的实施计划(存 .omo);它不修改产品代码,实际执行要由你另行启动。
howto.when: 只在你明确要求使用 ulw-plan 流程、或提出“先做计划再实施”时才启用;单独跑一次普通的 ulw 不会自动触发它。

say.text: 请用 ulw-plan 模式先给登录接口改造做份计划,先别写代码。
say.note: 只会做探索和计划,不会动手实现。

say.text: 用 ulw-plan 探索后告诉我改哪些文件、按什么顺序。
say.note: 会读代码并产出分步计划。

say.text: 把这个需求按 ulw-plan 出成完整计划,等我确认后再实行。
say.note: 批准前只出计划,执行需另行启动。

howto.what_en: Once enabled, Claude works as a planning consultant: it explores the code and intent, then, after your approval, writes an executable plan under .omo. It never touches product code; actual execution is started by you.
howto.when_en: Activates only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow or for a plan before implementation; a bare ordinary ulw run will not auto-trigger it.

say_en.text: Please use ulw-plan to plan the login change first — don't code yet.
say_en.note: Enters planning mode; research and plan only.

say_en.text: Use ulw-plan to explore, then tell me which files to change and in what order.
say_en.note: Reads the code and drafts a step plan.

say_en.text: Turn this request into a full ulw-plan plan; wait for my go before implementing.
say_en.note: Plan only; execution must be started later by you.
